method: Actual unchanged final application; one browser at a time; real native RAF/performance.now untouched. Initial shared3CPU ABBA and subsequent shared3CPU wheel/pixel ABBA fully retained. Remaining pixel variance tested with identical renderer-main/worker CPU allocation and neutral real visibility before every ABBA phase; all336work/334interval samples per side accepted in that separate profile. Unlike CPU profiles are not pooled; no product code or quality changes; all failed/interrupted records remain versioned. Controlled motion timestamps are an explicit diagnostic, not original-time footage or hardware FPS.
